note: 30 candidates in this part. The session's shared web-search allowance was used up after five searches, so the rest was found by reading official county, city and court sites and the pages already linked from the record (party candidate lists, the two campaign sites). Many county sites did not resolve (Carroll, Marion, Mercer, Pulaski, Simpson, Clinton, Owsley, Breckinridge) and Louisville's Metro Council pages answer 403, so most constables, magistrates, the jailer, the coroner and the school board candidates are left blank. Looked at and not recorded: Danville's City Commission page does not list Stephen P. Ellis; no Hopkinsville ward page lists Angelita O. Atkins; Woodford County's directory does not name Amanda Centers; Nick Wilson (a sitting legislator) has no campaign site that could be found. Party candidate lists that do not say endorsed (Fayette County Democrats for Angela Evans, Daviess County Democrats for Rhondalyn Randolph, Hardin County Republicans for Brad Luebbert, the Republican Party of Kentucky for Nick Wilson) are already in ballot/lean/ky_endorsements.json and are not repeated as endorsements. No birth year is recorded for Angela Evans. Verifier: every url re-opened (several through the kit's patient fetcher after the router lost lookups); all findings confirmed; one staff-post remark about a person not in this part's findings was taken out of this note (a job, not an office).
